content: PostgreSQL is the chosen database for production.
Local development uses SQLite (while production uses PostgreSQL, per database.production decision).
opencode resolves plugin binaries from the config directory only; plugin lookup does not fall back to or trust PATH, so a plugin found only on PATH is rejected.
Database migrations are additive only. We never rewrite a row within a single migration.

Never acquire a second database connection while a transaction is already open on the first. The pool blocks waiting for the open-transaction connection to be returned, but it never is, so the call deadlocks. This footgun cost a full day of debugging once. Reuse the transaction's own connection for any work done inside the transaction.
